# AI Task Manager (shared core)

This project uses the shared AI Task Manager core. The full operational skill lives in the core and changes together with it, so it is read live instead of being copied here.

1. Call the `ai-task-manager` MCP tool `server_info` with `project_root` set to this project's absolute root.
2. Read the file at `skill_path` from the result completely and follow it for every task operation; resolve its relative links from that file's directory.
3. If the tool is unavailable, `project_root_allowed` is false, or the file cannot be read, stop and report the exact limitation (for example: run `ai-task-manager setup --project-root <this project>` or register the MCP server). Do not reconstruct the workflow from memory.
